headline: The Canberra Mob stuns The Dude Abides on Monday night

games.headline: The Canberra Mob stuns The Dude Abides on Monday night
article: The Canberra Mob beat The Dude Abides 140.50 to 136.70 in Week 9, a nail-biter decided by 3.80 points.

The Canberra Mob put up 140.50 this week, 40.4 over their projected 100.1 and the 2nd-highest score of the week. CeeDee Lamb carried them with 29.5 points, 11.8 over his projection. Matthew Golden (27.4) and Bills D/ST (16.0) were the other big contributors.

The Dude Abides put up 136.70 this week, 17.3 over their projected 119.4 and the 3rd-highest score of the week. Ja'Marr Chase led the way with 27.5, and Bucky Irving added 26.5. The Dude Abides scored the 3rd-most points in the league this week and still lost. Brutal.
The letdown for The Dude Abides was Adonai Mitchell, who managed 0.0 on a 9.5 projection.
Here's the painful part for The Dude Abides: starting Devaughn Vele (2.7) instead of Adonai Mitchell (0.0) would have produced 145.60 points, enough to win.
Going into Monday night, The Canberra Mob trailed by 0.20 and needed a big night. Bills D/ST (16.0) delivered, while The Dude Abides got just 12.0 from Tyler Bass.
The Canberra Mob improves to 4-5 (8th place). The Dude Abides drops to 4-5 (5th).

Next week, The Canberra Mob faces King Henry (3-6), who are coming off a 13.3-point loss to Stroud and Proud and have lost 4 straight. The Canberra Mob will be without Tez Johnson (bye), so it's time to check the waiver wire.

Next week, The Dude Abides faces Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup (3-6), who are coming off a 12.4-point win over * Go Buckeyes. The Dude Abides will be without Bucky Irving (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.

games.headline: Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup takes care of * Go Buckeyes
article: Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup beat * Go Buckeyes 100.70 to 88.30 in Week 9, a solid win decided by 12.40 points.

Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup put up 100.70 this week, 13.4 under their projected 114.1. Dak Prescott carried them with 24.1 points. KC Concepcion (20.8) and Travis Kelce (15.3) were the other big contributors.
* Go Buckeyes managed 88.30 this week, 6.9 under their projected 95.2 and the 2nd-lowest score of the week. Bryce Young led the way with 26.3, and Spencer Shrader added 13.0.
The letdown for Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup was Jonathan Taylor, who managed 6.9 on a 18.4 projection.
Here's the painful part for * Go Buckeyes: starting Denzel Boston (12.8) instead of Malik Washington (3.1) would have produced 101.80 points, enough to win.
Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup improves to 3-6 (11th place). * Go Buckeyes drops to 1-8 (12th) and has now lost 6 in a row.
Next week, Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup faces The Dude Abides (4-5), who are coming off a 3.8-point loss to The Canberra Mob.
Next week, * Go Buckeyes faces K9 Unit (8-1), who are coming off a 72.1-point win over Oops and have won 7 straight.

games.headline: Stroud and Proud handles King Henry
article: Stroud and Proud beat King Henry 110.90 to 97.60 in Week 9, a solid win decided by 13.30 points.

Stroud and Proud put up 110.90 this week, 7.4 under their projected 118.3. C.J. Stroud carried them with 51.0 points, nearly half of the team's total, 31.1 over his projection. Chris Olave (13.3) and Texans D/ST (10.0) were the other big contributors.
King Henry managed 97.60 this week, 17.5 under their projected 115.1. Puka Nacua led the way with 28.0, and Luther Burden III added 21.2.

The letdown for King Henry was Malik Willis, who managed 3.7 on a 20.1 projection. King Henry might have a quarterback decision to make if Willis doesn't figure it out: Geno Smith is sitting right there on the bench.
The letdown for Stroud and Proud was Jaxon Smith-Njigba, who managed 8.6 on a 19.0 projection.
King Henry left 11.10 points on the bench, with Rams D/ST (12.0) and Geno Smith (6.8) sitting, though even that wouldn't have been enough.
At quarterback, C.J. Stroud (51.0) outdueled Malik Willis (3.7).
Stroud and Proud improves to 6-3 (3rd place). King Henry drops to 3-6 (9th) and has now lost 4 in a row.
Next week, Stroud and Proud faces Slim Shiesties (6-3), who are coming off a 20.3-point win over I Call Gibbs.

Next week, King Henry faces The Canberra Mob (4-5), who are coming off a 3.8-point win over The Dude Abides. King Henry will be without Luther Burden III and Jonah Coleman (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.

games.headline: Dena's Team 🏈 beats Ken
article: Dena's Team 🏈 beat Ken 101.60 to 87.80 in Week 9, a solid win decided by 13.80 points.

Dena's Team 🏈 put up 101.60 this week, 11.3 under their projected 112.9. Brock Purdy carried them with 29.0 points, about a quarter of the team's total. Javonte Williams (20.4) and Jaguars D/ST (12.0) were the other big contributors.
Ken managed 87.80 this week, 35.0 under their projected 122.8 and the lowest score in the league. Christian McCaffrey led the way with 21.7, and Trevor Lawrence added 17.9.
The letdown for Ken was Josh Jacobs, who managed 0.5 on a 14.7 projection.
The letdown for Dena's Team 🏈 was Justin Jefferson, who managed 7.3 on a 15.1 projection.
Ken left 12.50 points on the bench, with DeMario Douglas (12.7) and Emeka Egbuka (5.4) sitting, though even that wouldn't have been enough.
At quarterback, Brock Purdy (29.0) outdueled Trevor Lawrence (17.9).

Going into Monday night, Dena's Team 🏈 led by 14.80, and Ken still had DJ Moore and Will Reichard to play. DJ Moore (5.1) and Will Reichard (7.0) put in work, but Dena's Team 🏈's Justin Jefferson (7.3) and Jordan Addison (3.8) more than answered.
Dena's Team 🏈 improves to 4-5 (7th place). Ken drops to 3-6 (10th).

Next week, Dena's Team 🏈 faces I Call Gibbs (8-1), who are coming off a 20.3-point loss to Slim Shiesties. Dena's Team 🏈 will be without Saquon Barkley and Dallas Goedert (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.
Next week, Ken faces Oops (4-5), who are coming off a 72.1-point loss to K9 Unit. Ken will be without Bears D/ST (bye), so the bench is about to get some work.

games.headline: Slim Shiesties beats I Call Gibbs
article: Slim Shiesties beat I Call Gibbs 111.20 to 90.90 in Week 9, a solid win decided by 20.30 points.
Joe Burrow carried them with 35.7 points, about a quarter of the team's total, 9.8 over his projection. Parker Washington (17.1) and James Cook III (16.7) were the other big contributors.
I Call Gibbs managed 90.90 this week, 24.6 under their projected 115.5 and the 3rd-lowest score of the week. Josh Allen led the way with 14.5, and Seahawks D/ST added 14.0.
The letdown for I Call Gibbs was Jahmyr Gibbs, who managed 13.4 on a 24.3 projection.
The letdown for Slim Shiesties was D'Andre Swift, who managed 3.1 on a 17.3 projection.
Not much I Call Gibbs could have done about this one: even their best possible lineup (97.90) wouldn't have caught Slim Shiesties.
At quarterback, Joe Burrow (35.7) outdueled Josh Allen (14.5).
Slim Shiesties improves to 6-3 (4th place). I Call Gibbs drops to 8-1 (2nd).

Next week, Slim Shiesties faces Stroud and Proud (6-3), who are coming off a 13.3-point win over King Henry. Slim Shiesties will be without D'Andre Swift, Jaylen Waddle and Broncos D/ST (bye), so the bench is about to get some work.
Next week, I Call Gibbs faces Dena's Team 🏈 (4-5), who are coming off a 13.8-point win over Ken.

games.headline: K9 Unit demolishes Oops
article: K9 Unit beat Oops 177.50 to 105.40 in Week 9, a beatdown decided by 72.10 points. Oops never stood a chance.

K9 Unit put up 177.50 this week, 55.0 over their projected 122.5 and the highest score in the league. Jordan Love carried them with 41.3 points, 20.2 over his projection. Kenneth Walker III (34.3) and Christian Watson (26.6) were the other big contributors.
Oops put up 105.40 this week, 8.2 under their projected 113.6. Drake Maye led the way with 23.3, and Rome Odunze added 14.0. That would have beaten most teams this week. Oops just ran into K9 Unit.
The letdown for Oops was Ashton Jeanty, who managed 4.5 on a 12.6 projection.
The letdown for K9 Unit was Jameson Williams, who managed 4.5 on a 11.9 projection.
Not much Oops could have done about this one: even their best possible lineup (105.40) wouldn't have caught K9 Unit.
At quarterback, Jordan Love (41.3) outdueled Drake Maye (23.3).
K9 Unit improves to 8-1 (1st place), winners of 7 straight. Oops drops to 4-5 (6th).
Next week, K9 Unit faces * Go Buckeyes (1-8), who are coming off a 12.4-point loss to Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup and have lost 6 straight.
Next week, Oops faces Ken (3-6), who are coming off a 13.8-point loss to Dena's Team 🏈. Oops will be without Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.
